title: Add timeout UI feedback for admin chat page
body: When the useCurrentUser fetch times out, the error is set to 'timeout' but the admin chat page at src/app/(payload)/admin/chat/page.tsx doesn't display the error state - it only checks isLoading and user. Consider adding error display when error.message === 'timeout' to show a user-friendly message like 'Failed to load. Please refresh the page.'
rationale: The timeout error is now captured but not surfaced to the user - they would still see 'Loading...' if the user fetch times out
